items.example: All of a sudden, the lights went off.
items.exampleTr: Birdenbire ışıklar söndü.
items.simple: Something happens very fast, and you did not expect it.

items.example: She called me out of the blue last night.
items.exampleTr: Dün gece durup dururken beni aradı.
items.simple: Something happens when nobody thought it would.

items.example: It dawned on me that I'd left the oven on.
items.exampleTr: Birden fırını açık bıraktığım aklıma geldi.
items.simple: You suddenly understand something you did not see before.

items.example: Little did I know, she was waiting outside.
items.exampleTr: Nereden bilebilirdim, o dışarıda bekliyordu.
items.simple: You did not know something that would happen soon.
items.note: Little did I know'dan sonra devrik cümle gelir: Little did I know that…

items.en: to cut a long story short
items.example: To cut a long story short, we missed the flight.
items.exampleTr: Uzun lafın kısası, uçağı kaçırdık.
items.simple: You say the short end of a long story.

items.example: Long story short, he quit and moved away.
items.exampleTr: Uzun lafın kısası, istifa edip taşındı.
items.simple: You tell only the main part, not all the little parts.

items.example: The thing is, I never really liked him.
items.exampleTr: Mesele şu ki, ondan hiç hoşlanmadım.
items.simple: You are about to say the most important point.

items.example: Anyway, back to what I was saying.
items.exampleTr: Her neyse, söylediğime dönersek.
items.simple: You go back to your story after a small break.

items.example: To be honest, I didn't enjoy it much.
items.exampleTr: Dürüst olmak gerekirse pek keyif almadım.
items.simple: You say what you really think.

items.example: Believe it or not, I won first prize.
items.exampleTr: İnan ya da inanma, birinci oldum.
items.simple: It is hard to believe, but it is true.

items.example: You won't believe this, but I met him again.
items.exampleTr: Buna inanmayacaksın ama onunla yine karşılaştım.
items.simple: You are going to tell something that seems very strange.

items.example: By the time we got there, it was over.
items.exampleTr: Biz oraya vardığımızda her şey bitmişti.
items.simple: When we got there, it had already ended.

items.example: The next thing I knew, I was on the floor.
items.exampleTr: Bir de baktım ki yerdeyim.
items.simple: Things went so fast that you noticed only at the end.

items.example: It turned out that he'd lied to us.
items.exampleTr: Meğerse bize yalan söylemiş.
items.simple: In the end, you found out the real thing.

items.example: As it turned out, we didn't need the map.
items.exampleTr: Sonradan anlaşıldı ki haritaya ihtiyacımız yokmuş.
items.simple: In the end, the truth was not what we thought.

items.example: Meanwhile, my brother was cooking dinner.
items.exampleTr: Bu arada kardeşim akşam yemeği yapıyordu.
items.simple: At the same time, something else was happening.

items.example: I ran into my old teacher at the shop.
items.exampleTr: Markette eski öğretmenimle karşılaştım.
items.simple: You meet someone by chance when you did not plan it.

items.example: I couldn't believe my eyes when I saw him.
items.exampleTr: Onu görünce gözlerime inanamadım.
items.simple: What you saw was so strange that you thought it was not real.

items.example: To make matters worse, it started raining.
items.exampleTr: İşleri daha da kötüleştirmek için yağmur başladı.
items.simple: You tell about one more bad thing on top of the others.

items.example: On top of that, I lost my wallet.
items.exampleTr: Bunun da üstüne cüzdanımı kaybettim.
items.simple: You add one more thing to what you said.

items.tr: bir anda, nereden çıktığı belli olmadan
items.example: A dog ran out of nowhere.
items.exampleTr: Bir köpek bir anda ortaya çıktı.
items.simple: Something appears and you did not see it before.

items.example: Before I knew it, it was midnight.
items.exampleTr: Fark etmeden gece yarısı olmuştu.
items.simple: Time passed so fast that you did not notice.

items.example: We got to the station in the nick of time.
items.exampleTr: İstasyona tam son anda yetiştik.
items.simple: You got there just before it was too late.
